title: Geologic Map of the Fort Jackson South Quadrangle, Calhoun and Richland Counties, South Carolina
citation: Meitzen, K.M., 2011, Geologic Map of the Fort Jackson South Quadrangle, Calhoun and Richland Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Geologic Quadrangle Map GQM-52, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR sheet with map, explanatory text, fault discussion, cross section A-A', figures. Text panels legible; map and section faces scattered. Several map symbols garbled (art/Qrt, [_2cb, [ |, [7 |, 5, |, [ues |) and left out; Qatv and Qacf inferred from placement; 'Qat' (section shows 'Qaf') and 'Tt' kept as printed. Fault data from the explanatory text (not legend); fault symbols, scarps, drill holes and well-log locations known only from the map/legend not recorded. Statements about the Poinsett State Park quadrangle and Congaree valley-fill thickness elsewhere not recorded.
SUBSURFACE: section A-A' (p.1; vertical scales in FEET 100-500 and METERS 30-150; VE 20; SEA LEVEL) — unit positions and elevations along it and its end locations are not legible in the OCR; Trt 2-4 bases on Upper Cretaceous with significant relief constrained by few drill holes (no elevations given). Map vertical datum not stated (horizontal 1927 North American Datum; contour interval 10 feet; base map USGS 1982). SCGS drill-hole and SCDNR well-log IDs on map (logs not included).
